name: Chandigarh

topAttractions.name: Rock Garden
topAttractions.description: A unique rock garden created from industrial and urban waste, showcasing the city's commitment to sustainability and creativity.

topAttractions.name: Sukhna Lake
topAttractions.description: A man-made lake that offers boating, walking, and picnic opportunities, surrounded by beautiful gardens and scenic views.

topAttractions.name: Rose Garden
topAttractions.description: A 30-acre garden featuring over 1,600 varieties of roses, making it one of the largest rose gardens in Asia.

bestTimeToVisit: October to March, when the weather is mild and pleasant, making it ideal for sightseeing and outdoor activities.
culturalFact: Chandigarh is home to the Government Museum and Art Gallery, which houses a collection of artifacts and artworks from the region, including a 2nd-century BCE Gandhara sculpture.

hiddenGem.name: Pinjore Gardens
hiddenGem.description: A lesser-known but equally beautiful garden complex featuring fountains, waterfalls, and walking trails, located just outside Chandigarh.

relatedFestival: Baisakhi, a harvest festival celebrated by the Sikh community, which is marked by processions, music, and traditional food.
passportTieIn: If you have stamps or wishlist items for Punjab or Haryana, you might want to consider visiting Chandigarh, as it is the joint capital of both states and offers a unique blend of their cultures and traditions.
